# AetherSkin

> AetherSkin is a free AI skin analysis tool, launching in beta. A selfie scan will
> read your skin and match you with skincare products from established brands. AetherSkin does not
> manufacture products; it earns affiliate commission on recommendations,
> disclosed on every placement.

AetherSkin is pre-launch. The public site collects free waitlist signups and a
short skin quiz. There is no payment at any stage.

## What AetherSkin does

- Reads everyday skin characteristics from a photo: hydration, texture,
  visible pores, dark spots, fine lines, breakouts.
- Builds a skin profile from a 10-question quiz (skin goal, skin type,
  daily environment, texture preference, sunscreen habit, stress level,
  routine complexity, age, sleep, water intake). Multiple choice and
  numbers only; no free text, no name.
- Matches that profile to products from brands the user already knows.

AetherSkin provides cosmetic and wellness guidance only. It is not a medical
device and does not diagnose, treat, or cure any condition.

## Pricing

Free. The waitlist, the skin quiz, and the launch scan carry no cost.
AetherSkin earns affiliate commission from retailers when a user buys a
recommended product; this never changes the price the user pays.
See /pricing.md for machine-readable detail.

## Key pages

- /: product overview and free waitlist signup
- /about: mission, affiliate-model transparency, privacy stance
- /privacy: data collected, retention periods, deletion rights
- /terms: waitlist terms, medical disclaimer, affiliate disclosure

## Facts

- Signup cost: $0
- Beta capacity: 500 early users
- Quiz length: 13 questions, about 2 minutes
- Data retention: 24 months from last interaction; unverified signups
  deleted after 90 days; verification links expire after 7 days
- Face scans: not collected pre-launch; will require separate explicit
  consent, and will never be used for model training without a distinct
  opt-in the user can decline

## Contact

A dedicated support address is being provisioned. Until then, replies to any
AetherSkin email reach the team.
